title: Typography / Type basics

location.series: IBM Design Language / public web guidelines
location.extent: Complete webpage content-area capture; interactive elements retain their captured state

slide_intent: Make the mechanics of typography support comfortable reading, because poor spacing, punctuation and hierarchy can interrupt meaning before readers notice the brand.
strategic_value: Consistent Plex alignment and restrained emphasis can make IBM communications feel organized and carefully executed.
demonstration: A long sequence of green-approved and red-rejected examples compares tracking, alignment, leading, punctuation, case, line breaks and headline hierarchy.
practical_value: Diagnose a typographic problem by comparing the relevant approved and rejected treatments.

content_islands.name: Orientation and resources
content_islands.spec: Begin with the Type basics title, introductory explanation, section links and Plex resource cards.

content_islands.name: Spacing and alignment
content_islands.spec: Compare comfortable tracking, flush-left paragraphs and leading using paired green and red examples.

content_islands.name: Punctuation and emphasis
content_islands.spec: Follow with apostrophes/primes, quotation marks, dashes, and restrained versus redundant emphasis.

content_islands.name: Case and line quality
content_islands.spec: Compare sentence case, rags, orphans and widows, then alignment with adjacent copy and imagery.

content_islands.name: Reading and hierarchy
content_islands.spec: Finish with the reading-length media state, container padding, stacked headlines and title/subtitle weight or scale relationships.

ingredient.name: Plex text setting
ingredient.role: Keep reading orderly and emphasis clear.
ingredient.application: Set copy flush left; use sentence case except proper titles, product names and service names; preserve comfortable spacing and avoid stacking emphasis styles.
ingredient.scope: IBM typography guidance shown on this captured page; line length and leading depend on the content and container, rather than a universal number.

reference_purposes.Intent: The introduction and section explanations connect typographic consistency, hierarchy and alignment to reading quality.
reference_purposes.Expression: The specimens show Plex’s light, open appearance in real phrases and paragraphs.
reference_purposes.Application: Paired examples teach corrections to tracking, alignment, line lengths and hierarchy.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The source sets flush left as IBM’s standard, directs sentence case with named exceptions, and rejects straight quotation marks and redundant emphasis.

inspection.method: Six uniformly spaced sampled frames across the complete clip
